benchmark_metadata.benchmark_environment: Native Physical Device via ADB Shell
benchmark_metadata.evaluator: Physical Empirical On-Device Tri-Engine Test (CPU vs GPU vs NNAPI)

model_details.task: PCB Defect Detection (YOLOv8/11 Nano INT8 PTQ)

gpu_mali_g72_opencl.verdict: FASTEST on-device execution on Exynos 9611. 100% graph mapped to Mali-G72 GPU shaders.

cpu_cortex_a73_xnnpack_4threads.verdict: LEAST MEMORY (45 MB) and fastest cold startup (79 ms). Ideal for low-power continuous edge worker.

nnapi_reference_fallback.delegated_operators: 0 / 387 (Driver rejected, fell back to reference CPU)
nnapi_reference_fallback.verdict: Standard Android NNAPI lacks proprietary vendor driver on Exynos 9611 for INT8 ops; direct OpenCL GPU or XNNPACK CPU is required.

comparative_insights.gpu_vs_cpu_delta: Mali-G72 GPU delivers 11.3% lower latency (130.36 ms vs 147.00 ms) and higher peak frame rate (8.8 FPS vs 7.6 FPS).
comparative_insights.memory_tradeoff: CPU consumes less than half the RAM of GPU (45.09 MB vs 102.90 MB) with instant cold boot (79 ms vs 2982 ms).
comparative_insights.production_deployment_recommendation: For battery-constrained handheld terminals, deploy CPU XNNPACK (45 MB RAM). For fixed inspection jigs with continuous power, deploy Mali-G72 GPU OpenCL (130 ms / 8.8 FPS).
